text:
mira: Quick sync — proposing an RBAC canary for BYOK/HSM operator changes next week. goal: validate least-priv before full rollout, and ensure audit logs are immutable and versioned. thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam: +1. Recommend two-phase canary: 1) dry-run with ops-canary role (no real unwrap), 2) controlled unwrap against a test tenant. Keep window <= 30m.

devon: Agree. We need to ensure the audit schema includes an operation_id and proof-hash so evidence can't be rewritten. Also need retention TTL aligned with compliance (7y for some customers).

arjun: Important callout: our current log store (qsink v2) allows edits during emergency patching. We should add an append-only write path for canary ops. Suggest storing signed event blobs in S3 with object-lock and separate index in DB.

mira: Good — can we prototype a minimal schema? sample: ```
{
  "ts": "%TIMESTAMP%",
  "actor": "operator:ops-canary/uid",
  "action": "unwrap|wrap|import",
  "target_key_id": "cust-1234/k1",
  "operation_id": "op-7361-xyz",
  "proof_hash": "sha256:...",
  "kms_response": {"status":"200","wrapped":true} // redact sensitive fields
}
```

sam: SGTM. Note: redact full wrapped_key material and any PKCS#11 tokens. Store redaction markers and a separate HSM-audit-only blob (encrypted with infra KMS) if needed.

sec-bot: Automated check: "canary write path uses object-lock = enabled" failed on staging. CI job: audit/log-immutability-check shows missing S3 retention tags.

mira: Devon/arjun — can you take remediation? also decide on fallback if HSM import fails mid-canary. Proposal: automatic rollback to host-managed wrapping for affected tenant, generate incident ticket, and mark operation as "fallback_used" in logs.

devon: I'll add a canary feature-flag and implement fallback marker. Patch plan: 1) enforce object-lock, 2) migration to add proof_hash column to audit index, 3) create fallback handler. Estimate 2 days + review.

arjun: I'll own the S3 object-lock + retention policy change and update CI. Will also add a smoke that simulates a 503 from KMS proxy and verifies fallback path kicks in.

oncall: Reminder: update oncall playbook with runbook steps and SLs for fallback path. If fallback_used flagged, auto-notify security-oncall and create postmortem draft.

mira: Also: vuln triage note — there was a related advisory about PKCS#11 session leakage (CVE-2026-XXXX). We should ensure canary operators can't escalate to session-attach. Add a test to validate session scoping.

sam: I'll open a short RFC with the schema + rollout timeline. Target canary start: Tue 2026-09-07 10:00 PT. Owners: devon (code), arjun (infra), mira (policy).

mira: Thanks — if anyone sees blockers reply here. Otherwise we'll gate merges behind the immutability CI check :lock:
